about_the_game: Nerds and Ammo is a first‑person puzzle platformer where husband‑and‑wife scientists, Dr. Isaac Screwit and Dr. Roxy Volt, are suddenly trapped inside their own high‑tech laboratory after an unexpected security lockdown. With the facility’s AI behaving… oddly, each room transforms into a physics‑based puzzle chamber packed with unpredictable hazards and bizarre contraptions. Armed with your trusty SCIENCE CANNON — a non‑lethal launcher that fires an arsenal of quirky projectiles to manipulate the environment — you’ll bounce, trigger, and outwit your way through increasingly devious challenges to escape before the lab’s chaos consumes you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0 (or higher) or AMD64X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 128 MB or more
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700k or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 - 8GB or AMD Radeon 6700 XT - 12GB

  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12 compatible

short_description: Two sexy Nerds need to escape a lab full of bad ideas. Outwit dangerous traps, wrangle chaotic gadgets, and survive science at its dumbest in this BRAND NEW and terribly cheesy puzzle platformer.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
